variants.text: Older man with short grey hair and a short grey mustache.
Older man with an oblong face, receding grey hairline, and a short grey mustache. He has a straight nose with a bulbous tip and a sharp jawline.

Older adult with an oblong facial shape, defined bone structure, and high forehead with horizontal creases. Features include a receding hairline, moderate brow ridge with soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped deep-set eyes, and a straight nasal bridge with a bulbous tip. The mouth has thin lips, the philtrum is short with defined ridges, and the jawline is sharp with a rounded chin. Ears are of moderate size with attached lobes. He has short grey hair styled back and a short grey mustache.

This is an older man with short, swept-back grey hair and a short grey mustache. He has a distinct oblong face with a sharp jawline and a prominent forehead with some horizontal lines. His nose is straight but rounded at the tip, and he has a serious, defined look with deep-set eyes.
